es.value: `contextlib` trae context managers listos. `suppress(TipoError)` ignora silenciosamente esa excepción dentro del bloque. `redirect_stdout(buffer)` desvía todo lo que se imprime a un buffer.
`suppress` es más limpio que un try/except vacío cuando solo quieres ignorar un error concreto.

en.value: `contextlib` brings ready-made context managers. `suppress(ErrorType)` silently ignores that exception inside the block. `redirect_stdout(buffer)` redirects everything printed to a buffer.
`suppress` is cleaner than an empty try/except when you just want to ignore one specific error.

prompt.es: Define `seguro(func)` que ejecute func() ignorando cualquier excepción (usa suppress) y devuelva su resultado, o None si falla.
prompt.en: Define `seguro(func)` that runs func() ignoring any exception (use suppress) and returns its result, or None on failure.

es: with suppress(Exception): return func(); fuera, return None.
en: with suppress(Exception): return func(); outside, return None.

tests.name: seguro
tests.harness:
assert seguro(lambda: 1 / 0) is None
assert seguro(lambda: 5) == 5

prompt.es: Define `capturar_salida(func)` que ejecute func() y devuelva todo lo que imprima (usa redirect_stdout).
prompt.en: Define `capturar_salida(func)` that runs func() and returns everything it prints (use redirect_stdout).

es: Crea un io.StringIO y redirige la salida con redirect_stdout.
en: Create an io.StringIO and redirect output with redirect_stdout.

tests.name: capturar_salida
tests.harness:
assert capturar_salida(lambda: print('hola')) == 'hola\n'
assert capturar_salida(lambda: print('a', 'b')) == 'a b\n'
